title: 1975 nuclear base incursions cable to the Pentagon
summary: Marik von Rennenkampf tells of 1975 nuclear base incursions cable to the Pentagon, about 1975 at US nuclear bases, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Marik von Rennenkampf, who writes about UFOs and government, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that people should read a 1975 cable, an official message sent to the Pentagon. He says it describes unknown objects intruding over US nuclear weapons bases that year, and he credits the researcher John Greenwald with bringing it to light. If true, it would show the military itself recording strange visits to its most sensitive sites.
